caption:
Why pray so much? The Prophet ﷺ answered with gratitude

Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba narrated that the Prophet ﷺ prayed so much that his feet became swollen. When asked why, he said, "Shall I not be a thankful slave (to Allah)?" Worship can be a way of saying thank you.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6471 · Grade: Sahih

Thank Allah for one blessing in your next prayer
